Actor.delver: A player character who ventures into the Unknown to keep the light burning.
Actor.npc: A person, horror or construct the Keeper runs.

Item.equipment: A weapon, a suit of armor, a lantern, or gear. Fills BODY record slots.
Item.feature: A special earned from a skill. Fills MIND record slots.
Item.adaptation: A mutation the Unknown has worked into a Delver. Fills WILL record slots.

Placeholder.DelverSheet: The Delver sheet is not built yet.
Placeholder.NpcSheet: The NPC statblock is not built yet.
Placeholder.ItemSheet: This record sheet is not built yet.

Warning.NoActiveGM: No Keeper is connected, so this change cannot be applied. Ask the Keeper to join.
Warning.NoQueryPermission: Your user role cannot send requests to the Keeper. The Keeper must grant the "Query Other Users" permission.
Warning.DelegateFailed: The Keeper's client could not complete that change. See the console for details.
Warning.AlreadyStrained: This test has already been strained.
Warning.NotEnoughBoons: There are not enough boons left for that.
Warning.WornLimit: Only {max} piece of armor can be worn at a time.
Warning.WrongColumn: {name} is a {type}. It does not go in the {column} column.
Warning.NoRoom: No room for {name}: {group} is at {used} of {max}, and it needs {cost}.
Warning.OverCapacity: Over capacity. Records past the limit do not work.
Warning.DestroyedIsForever: A destroyed record cannot be restored. Delete it instead.
Warning.ActionSpent: Your {cost} is already spent this turn.
Warning.NoBoonOptions: Nothing those boons can buy here.

Migration.Started: Time Without Tide is migrating this world. Do not close the browser.
Migration.Complete: Time Without Tide finished migrating this world.
Migration.Failed: Time Without Tide could not finish migrating this world. See the console and restore a backup.

AutoRecoveryTest.Name: Roll recovery tests automatically
AutoRecoveryTest.Hint: When a health pool reaches 0, roll the recovery test at once. Off prompts for it instead.

AutoArmorRefill.Name: Refill armor each turn
AutoArmorRefill.Hint: Restore armor to its full value at the start of each combatant's turn.

AutoUnknownExposure.Name: Prompt unwarded exposure
AutoUnknownExposure.Hint: Check unwarded actors against the Unknown at the end of each combat turn and each travel segment.

EnforceSlotLimits.Name: Enforce record slot limits
EnforceSlotLimits.Hint: Refuse a record that would overflow its slot group. Off warns and allows it.

SheetTheme.Name: Sheet theme
SheetTheme.Hint: Which surface the sheets are painted on. Affects only your own client.

skill.label: Skill
skill.hint: The skill this feature was earned from. Leave blank for a background feature.

tier.label: Tier
tier.hint: Junior is earned at skill 2, veteran at skill 4.

targetDifficulty.label: Target Difficulty
targetDifficulty.hint: The marks an attacker needs to hit this actor. The standard is 2.

warded.label: Warded
warded.hint: Whether this actor currently stands in warded light.

score.label: Body Score
score.hint: 1 to 5. Also the size of the Body health pool.

score.label: Mind Score
score.hint: 1 to 5. Also the size of the Mind health pool.

score.label: Will Score
score.hint: 1 to 5. Also the size of the Will health pool.

current.label: Armor Remaining
current.hint: Refills to its full value at the start of each of this Delver's combat turns.

temp.label: Bonus Armor
temp.hint: Armor granted on top of what the worn piece provides.

base.label: Speed
base.hint: Zones moved with a single move action, before conditions.

threat.label: Threat
threat.hint: How dangerous this creature is relative to one Delver.

size.label: Size
size.hint: In zones. Half a zone and up.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.hint: The one line printed under the name in the statblock.

base.label: Armor
base.hint: Body damage this creature absorbs each turn.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.hint: Leave blank to use the target's own target difficulty.

boons.label: Boons
boons.hint: Spend 2 boons to gain +1 speed for this action.

rules.label: Rules
rules.hint: Mechanical text the Keeper adjudicates. The system does not automate it.

restoreTrigger.label: Restored By
restoreTrigger.hint: What restores this record. For example: as a 1-hour action, succeed a Mind + Culture test.

Item.DestroyedBanner: Destroyed. This record is gone for good; a Safe Rest will not bring it back.
Item.ExhaustedBanner: Exhausted. Restore it before it can be used again.
Item.WeaponModeHint: Range 0 with Body is melee. Range 1 or more with Mind is ranged, with Body it is thrown.
Item.RestoreMalignantBody: Restoring {name} removes it entirely. A malignant adaptation is shed, not repaired. This cannot be undone.

heavy.label: Heavy
heavy.hint: Fills two Body record slots instead of one.

attackTrait.label: Attack Trait
attackTrait.hint: Body for melee and thrown, Mind for ranged.

armorBonus.label: Armor
armorBonus.hint: Body damage this piece absorbs each turn.

wardValue.label: Ward
wardValue.hint: Ward this lantern provides while wielded.

line.label: Line
line.hint: The mutation line, such as Undying or Fortune.

tier.label: Tier
tier.hint: How far down the line this Delver has been dragged.

Adaptation.MalignantNote: Malignant, and always detrimental. Restoring it is how a Delver is rid of it.

Modifier.BlindedSight: Blinded, and the action depends on sight

Test.AssistHint: One ally at most. They contribute half their score in the tested skill, rounded up.
Test.FlooredNote: Difficulty cannot fall below 1M, so the surplus becomes boons instead:

Strain.Title: Strain
Strain.Prompt: Choose which dice to reroll. You may reroll any of them, including an ally's assist dice.
Strain.Cost: Straining costs 1 Mind damage, once per test.

Boon.Title: Spend Boons
Boon.Available: {boons} boons to spend. They cannot be banked.
Boon.NoBanking: Anything unspent is lost when this moment passes.
Boon.FlurryHint: Strike again against the same target.
Boon.CleaveHint: Carry the blow into a second target within reach.
Boon.AdvantageHint: Take a position the fiction would not otherwise grant you.
Boon.DetailHint: Ask the Keeper one thing the situation would reveal.
Boon.ProjectHint: Add 1 success to the project you are working on.

Card.FlooredLine: Requested {requested}M, so the test was 1M and granted {bonus} bonus boons.
Card.PoolEmpty: The pool is empty. Roll to recover.
Card.RecoverySuccess: Back from the brink at 1 health.
Card.RecoveryFailure: Critical, and something has taken root.
Card.ManifestedNoSlot: A {line} mutation tried to take hold with no slot to hold it. 1 Will damage instead.
Card.PuppetOfTheUnknown: They become a puppet of the Unknown. Pray they are never seen again.
Card.RestHealed: All three health pools are full, and armor is whole.

Recovery.NoSlotSource: an adaptation with nowhere to go
Recovery.MalignantRestore: Restore this adaptation to be rid of it.

Genius.Name: Genius
Genius.MalignantText: Your brain is painfully swelling against your skull. Whenever you strain, reduce your dice pool by -2; minimum 1.
Genius.Awakened1Text: Thinking causes your grey matter to loudly throb. Whenever you strain, increase your dice pool by half your MIND.

Scorpion.Name: Scorpion
Scorpion.MalignantText: A sharp knuckle-spur juts from your tailbone. Whenever you unsuccessfully attack, take 1 piercing BODY damage.
Scorpion.Awakened1Text: A skeletal halberd looms above you at all times. You can make melee attacks using your sharp tail. It deals 2 BODY damage.

Telekinetic.Name: Telekinetic
Telekinetic.MalignantText: Objects around you twitch and jump unpredictably. You must use a major action to equip or pass items.
Telekinetic.Awakened1Text: Whatever you reach for leaps into your hand. Once per round during your turn, you can equip or pass without using a minor action.

Damage.SourcePlaceholder: A sledgehammer, the fog, a bad idea
Damage.NoTargets: Select at least one token first.

Rest.ConfirmBody: Three days of rest. Health pools refill, exhausted records are restored, charges come back, conditions clear, and malignant adaptations are shed. Destroyed records stay destroyed.

Action.NotInCombat: Not in an encounter. The action economy is the table's to track.

Assist.Label: Assist
Assist.Hint: Until your next turn starts, assist one ally's test within reach or weapon range.

Attack.Label: Attack
Attack.Hint: Strike with a wielded weapon, or with whatever is to hand.
Attack.Exhausted: {name} was not built for this. It is exhausted.

Brace.Label: Brace
Brace.Hint: Body + Industry. Gain 1 temporary armor until your next turn.

Dash.Label: Dash
Dash.Hint: Body + Navigation. Move with +1 speed. On a failure you may still move normally.
Dash.Anyway: Failed, but the move still happens at normal speed.

Direct.Label: Direct
Direct.Hint: Will + Culture. Invigorate one ally within 2 range.

Grapple.Label: Grapple
Grapple.Hint: Body + Violence. Contest a creature in reach to inflict Grappled.

Repel.Label: Repel
Repel.Hint: Assign your ward, then Will + Survival. Deal 1 Will damage to each horror in your warded zones.
Repel.Gained: 1 Will damage to each horror in the warded zones.

Search.Label: Search
Search.Hint: Mind + Skulduggery. Detect hidden creatures within 2 range.

Shove.Label: Shove
Shove.Hint: Body + Navigation. Push an enemy in reach 1 zone, or knock them Prone.

Move.Label: Move
Move.Hint: Leave your zone and enter an adjacent one, up to your speed.

Equip.Label: Equip
Equip.Hint: Equip and unequip any number of records within your limits.

Pass.Label: Pass
Pass.Hint: 1M Body + Culture. Hand or throw one record to an ally within 1 range.

Shine.Label: Shine
Shine.Hint: Assign ward to zones up to your ward value, your own included.

BreakGrapple.Label: Break Grapple
BreakGrapple.Hint: Contest the grapple to break free.

StandUp.Label: Stand Up
StandUp.Hint: Costs 1 speed, or this minor action.

Attack.Label: Attack with {weapon}
Attack.UnarmedBoon: Spend 1 boon to grapple the target, or push them 1 zone.
Attack.ImprovisedBoon: Spend 1 boon to destroy the object for +1 damage.

Zone.CoverModifier: Cover: the target is in woods
Zone.WardDisrupted: {name} was moved. {zones} warded zone or zones went dark.

terrain.label: Terrain
terrain.hint: Offered as a test modifier, never applied silently.

adjacent.label: Adjacent Zones
adjacent.hint: Drawn by you, not inferred from the map. Two regions can touch and still be a world apart.

Ward.Title: Assign Ward
Ward.ZoneLead: Light your own zone first, then outward. Each point covers one zone.
Ward.TravelLead: Pool the party's lanterns. Each point protects one Delver for the segment.
Ward.NoOrigin: This Delver is not standing in a zone.
Ward.NoZones: This scene has no zones. Ward is the toggle on the sheet.

Travel.AdvanceHint: End this segment: expose the unwarded, check fatigue, move the clock.
Travel.CampHint: Sleep. Clears Fatigued and resets the counter.
Travel.RelayHint: Return the party to its attuned beacon.
Travel.RelayBody: {names} step into the light and are gone.

Project.BoonsAdded: {boons} boons spent, each worth a success.
